/bin/bash -lc "python3 -c \"
import pandas as pd, re
df=pd.read_excel('mixed_units_register.xlsx', sheet_name='Disbursement Register', skiprows=5)
def parse_amount(v):
    if pd.isna(v):
        return 0.0
    s=str(v).strip()
    if s in ('','-','NA','NaN'):
        return 0.0
    # remove rupee sign and commas
    s=s.replace('₹','').replace(',','').strip()
    # handle lakh / L
    m=re.match(r'"'^([0-9]*'"\\.?[0-9]+)\\s*(lakh|L)"'$'"', s, re.I)
    if m:
        return float(m.group(1))*100000
    m=re.match(r'"'^([0-9]*'"\\.?[0-9]+)\\s*lakh"'$'"', s, re.I)
    if m:
        return float(m.group(1))*100000
    m=re.match(r'"'^([0-9]*'"\\.?[0-9]+)\\s*Cr"'$'"', s, re.I)
    if m:
        return float(m.group(1))*10000000
    m=re.match(r'"'^([0-9]*'"\\.?[0-9]+)\\s*k"'$'"', s, re.I)
    if m:
        return float(m.group(1))*1000
    # plain number
    try:
        return float(s)
    except:
        return 0.0
df['amount_num']=df['Amount'].apply(parse_amount)
total=df['amount_num'].sum()
karn=df.loc[df['State'].str.strip().str.lower()=='karnataka','amount_num'].sum()
perc=karn/total*100 if total else 0
print('total',total)
print('karn',karn)
print('perc',perc)
\"
"
